request:
Which functions or methods in the click library (src/click/) directly call both the style function from src/click/termui.py and the echo function from src/click/utils.py? Give the symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Joins call edges so the same caller directly calls both the style function in src/click/termui.py and the echo function in src/click/utils.py. It filters to functions/methods within src/click/ and returns each distinct caller symbol ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce1.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce1 JOIN code.call_edges ce2 ON ce1.caller_symbol_id = ce2.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols s1 ON s1.symbol_id = ce1.callee_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols s2 ON s2.symbol_id = ce2.callee_symbol_id WHERE s1.name = 'style' AND s1.file_id = 'src/click/termui.py' AND s2.name = 'echo' AND s2.file_id = 'src/click/utils.py' AND ce1.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce2.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce1.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND ce2.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' ORDER BY symbol_id
